name: Vanguard International Semiconductor Corporation
summary: Vanguard International Semiconductor Corporation, together with its affiliated companies, operates as a comprehensive global player in the semiconductor industry. Established in 1994 and based in Hsinchu, Taiwan, the firm delivers end-to-end services, encompassing the computer-aided design, manufacturing, packaging, quality assurance, and distribution of integrated circuits and various other semiconductor components. The company's advanced foundry capabilities extend across a diverse portfolio of specialized process technologies. These include high voltage, ultra-high voltage, Bipolar-CMOS-DMOS (BCD), Silicon-on-Insulator (SOI), discrete, mixed-signal, analog, and embedded flash technologies. Furthermore, Vanguard is actively involved in the production and supply of masks. Beyond its core manufacturing, the company provides an extensive array of supplementary services. These comprise multi-project wafer fabrication, a complete suite of mask services (covering frame generation, production, and repair), and a broad range of backend solutions. The backend offerings specifically include front-side and backside metallization, chip probing, gallium nitride compound semiconductor material processing, wafer-level chip scale packaging (WLCSP), and redistribution layer (RDL) development. Additionally, Vanguard offers tailored services for the automotive sector, alongside intelligent manufacturing and management systems.
